rows.grounds: object of the gerund taptvā; cognate accusative
absolutive expressing completed action prior to implied result
locative compound indicating locations other than Viṣṇupuṣkara
duration expressed by genitive plural with numeral noun ayutam

items.question: Can ten thousand years of austerity at other holy places equal the merit of dwelling at Viṣṇupuṣkara?
premises: A person may perform austerity at other holy places.
Such austerity may continue for ten thousand years.
This prolonged effort is presented as a measure of comparative merit.
items.inference: Even extreme and prolonged austerity elsewhere is set as a benchmark against the merit of residing at Viṣṇupuṣkara.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete without the following comparative result stated in adjacent verses.
items.plain_english: A person, having performed austerity at other holy places for ten thousand years...
